newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis Air to make new share offer.
newsitem.headline: Tunis Air to make new share offer.

text.p: Tunisia's state-controlled Tunis Air will make a new share offer as part of the government's privatisation programme, a senior Tunisian official said on Thursday.

"We are preparing a new public offer of shares for the next months," Moncef Ben Abdallah, Secretary of State at the Economic Development Ministry in charge of privatisations told a meeting of the Tunisian American Chamber of Commerce.
He gave no details on the value of the stake to be sold through the Tunis Stock Exchange, but banking sources said it would be up to 20 percent of the company's capital.
Tunis Air last year sold 20 percent of its capital in the biggest privatisation of the company so far, for an amount of 32 million dinars ($32.6 million).
It has a capital of 30 million dinars.
Tunis Air share was priced at 19.95 dinars. ($=0.98 dinar)
